name: farsiui-calendar
description: Official Iranian public holidays and optional events for Jalali years. Date conversion is not included — consumers use a Jalali library (e.g. @internationalized/date).

license.note: Only high-confidence national fixed holidays are published. This is not a complete official calendar. Hijri-based religious holidays are omitted until verified per year against an authoritative source.

sources.description: Established fixed Jalali national public holidays (Nowruz period, 12 Farvardin, 13 Farvardin, 14–15 Khordad, 22 Bahman, 29 Esfand).
MIT Time.ir-derived JSON/ICS. Useful for future seeding; not imported in this draft.
Broad SQLite archive from time.ir. Not imported; license unclear.
Per-day dumps with noise/duplicates and no clear license. Not used.

cdn.pinnedRefNote: For production, pin a git tag (e.g. calendar-1405.0.0) instead of @latest.

notes: Friday is a weekend day in Iran but is not listed as a holiday item; clients should treat weekends separately.
1405 Esfand has 29 days (non-leap in the algorithmic 33-year cycle used by @internationalized/date PersianCalendar).
Schema is designed for FarsiUI calendar UI to import JSON statically or fetch via jsDelivr.
